desc: Formalize the game state: claimed set S, remaining tokens; moves on claimed indices are pure stalls (pool), only strategic choice is when/which new index to claim.
Derive the optimal strategy via parity induction: for u≥4 unopened piles, mover wins iff (pool_parity + #even_unopened + u) is odd; base cases u=1,2,3 computed directly.

Winning condition: initial state pool=0, u=N → Fennec wins iff (N + e) odd for N≥4 (e = count of even A_i); special cases N=1 (Fennec), N=2 (Snuke), N=3 (Fennec iff some A_i odd). Verified against samples 1–3 and numerous hand simulations.
Implement O(N) solution (no sorting needed — only parity count) reading stdin, printing Fennec/Snuke; handle N=1,2,3 edge cases; final code review.
